verdict_note: How the release gate reads this leg (full_parity_gate._committed_verdict): a live GAP reproduces this record and is gate-passing, a live FAIL is excused by nothing. The per-record verdict below is tap_gate.py raw output on the recording run, scored against fp32, and device_floor.py never reads it.
note: One record per Tensix compute grid. scripts/af2_port/device_floor.py scores a live report against the record with the same compute_grid and FAILs when there is none; an unmeasured grid is not a blessed grid.
why_grid_keyed: With the template pair stack on the host the tap set is grid-invariant (3e4b4900, arms at 11x10 and 10x10 bit-identical). With it on the card it is not: the same p150a board scores 8 failing taps at 13x10 and 13 at 11x10 (77248e1f, which retracts the earlier grid refutation because TT_BIO_FORCE_GRID only shrinks, so a refutation proved from the smaller-grid box tests one direction). release_gate.py:2862 already applies this convention to every size-ladder census.

provenance.cause: 0d89524e8 made the AF2 host LayerNorm one F.layer_norm call for the exact-variance case (the same float32 arithmetic in one pass; final atom positions move by 1e-6 A on the CPU reference). Gate legs on main 28e026ba4 fail this leg on i_ptm (0.007541 > 1.10x 0.004426). Bisected on g108: tree-943a5f8c7 (0d89524e8 in, nothing else AF2-side since 803db0fc1) reproduces the failing report to 6 digits on pool/20, and so does main's numerics on pool/19 (tree-451e8388d, TT_BIO_OPM_DEPTH_JOIN=0); 497eac10a moves nothing. A 1e-7 relative change in a float32 norm feeding a bfloat16 structure module flips roundings, so this is the realisation floor moving, not an accuracy change. Scalars vs float32, old -> new: plddt 0.0052 -> 0.0050, ptm 0.0026 -> 0.0019, i_ptm 0.0044 -> 0.0075, pae 0.0016 -> 0.0005, i_pae 0.0001 -> 0.0020, unscaled_i_pae 0.0028 -> 0.0624. pcc_min 0.9962 -> 0.9953, taps failed 9 -> 9. Recorded from the gate's own live report (g108 pool/19), unchanged.

Two things moved out from under it. de780ab7 (2026-08-21 16:32Z, six hours after the floor was taken) moved that stack onto the card in ttnn bf16, upstream of all 52 trunk blocks, for 24.302 s -> 1.412 s, 17.2x. Card firmware then moved 19.8.1.0 -> 19.15.0.0, which moves the p150a Tensix grid 13x10 -> 11x10. The gate has been scoring an on-card stack at 11x10 against a host-arm floor taken at 13x10 ever since, and reporting the difference as an accuracy FAIL of the port.
